home.founderHeading: Born in Yunnan. Shaped by Experiences Abroad.
home.founderAlt: Joy Liu, founder of Hidden China Travel
home.founderP1: I grew up in Yunnan and later lived in Japan and the Philippines.
home.founderP2: Living abroad meant becoming the foreign visitor myself. Everyday tasks that local people take for granted, such as making payments, using transportation or understanding unfamiliar systems, suddenly required more preparation and trusted local context.
home.founderP3: That experience changed the way I think about travel.
home.founderP4: I created Hidden China Travel to help international visitors experience Yunnan with fewer uncertainties, more personal support and enough time to appreciate the places between the famous landmarks.
home.founderP5: I am your travel consultant at Yunnan Meizhen International Travel Agency. I help shape the route, then the agency confirms the contract, receives payment and operates the journey.

faqs: How much does a private Yunnan journey cost?

Pricing depends on the route, number of travelers, travel dates and hotel standard. After learning more about your plans, we will provide a tailored quotation with the inclusions and exclusions clearly explained.
Can the itinerary be customized?

Yes. Suggested journeys are starting points rather than fixed packages. We can adjust the number of days, pace, hotels, destinations, activities and level of guiding according to your group’s interests and requirements.
Do I need to pay before receiving a proposed route?
No. You can begin by sharing your dates, approximate trip length, group size and interests. Payment is only discussed after you have reviewed the proposed arrangements and quotation.
Who operates the journey in Yunnan?

Hidden China Travel is the English-language site of {agencyEn} ({agencyZh}), a licensed travel agency in Kunming. Joy Liu is your travel consultant. You speak with Joy from the first enquiry through the journey.
How do payment and cancellation work?

After you confirm the written itinerary and travel contract, pay a 20% deposit to {agencyEn}’s corporate account by Alipay, WeChat, or bank transfer. The account name matches the company on the contract. We then book hotels, tickets and the vehicle. The remaining 80% is due after your first pickup, when the journey starts. Cancel more than 7 days before the journey starts and the deposit is refunded, minus hotel or ticket costs that have already been booked and cannot be recovered. Cancellations 7 days or fewer before departure keep the deposit.
What is normally included?

Inclusions vary by journey but include private transport, a driver-guide throughout, accommodation and selected attraction tickets. Your proposal states what is included and what you pay for separately. The agency holds 2026 travel-agency liability insurance with China Pacific Property Insurance, policy AKUM0AC10625QAAA1R9T, up to RMB 1.8 million per person for injury it is legally responsible for. It applies to you only after your name and passport number are registered. Buy your own international medical and evacuation insurance. It is not included.
How soon will I receive a reply?
Joy normally replies within 2 hours on weekdays, 9:00–18:00 Beijing time, and within 24 hours at other times. More detailed proposals may take longer for complex routes or busy dates.

journey.yunnanNotesHeading: A few things to know about Yunnan.
journey.yunnanNotesSub: Elevation, sun, clothing, custom, and food.

yunnanNotes.title: Altitude
yunnanNotes.copy: Yunnan is a mountain plateau. Most places sit at a moderate elevation, and some are high. Lijiang is about 2,400 meters (7,900 feet), and Shangri-La about 3,400 meters (11,200 feet). If your route includes either, prepare for the altitude.

yunnanNotes.title: Sun
yunnanNotes.copy: The elevation makes the ultraviolet light strong in every season. Bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

yunnanNotes.title: Clothing
yunnanNotes.copy: The temperature can swing sharply, sometimes through several seasons in a single day. Dress in layers so you can add or remove a piece as it changes.

yunnanNotes.title: Local custom
yunnanNotes.copy: Yunnan is home to more ethnic groups than any other province in China, and customs differ from place to place. During visits, follow local practice and treat people’s homes, temples, and ceremonies with respect.

yunnanNotes.title: Food
yunnanNotes.copy: The cooking changes with the region. Dishes worth seeking out include crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, Xuanwei ham, flower cakes, Dai-style rice eaten by hand, and steam-pot chicken.

faqs: Can I start from one of your existing itineraries?
Yes. Tell us which journey caught your eye and what you would change. We can discuss a different duration, extra stops, hotel preferences or a gentler pace rather than starting from a blank page.
Do I need to know my dates and budget already?
No. A month, a rough trip length or a few places you like is enough to start. We will clarify dates, party size and priorities before preparing a meaningful quote.
Do you plan trips beyond Yunnan?
Yunnan is our starting point and the region we know best. If your plans include other parts of China, tell us where you would like to go. We will discuss what we can arrange before promising it.
How is a custom private journey priced?

The quote depends on your dates, route, party size, accommodation, transport, guide language and chosen activities. It will state the currency, inclusions, exclusions and payment terms before you decide. Budget ranges in the form are planning preferences, not advertised tour prices.
Is this a group tour?

The journey is planned for your own party, rather than joining a scheduled coach group. Public attractions, restaurants or activities may still be shared with other visitors; your proposal will clarify any shared arrangements.
Can you accommodate family, dietary or accessibility needs?
Please describe what matters to you in the form. We will check the relevant hotel, vehicle, food and activity arrangements before confirming whether they can be met.
Can you arrange a Muslim-friendly journey?

Yes. Muslim-friendly arrangements are a standard feature on every private journey, including tailor-made routes. Tell Joy at enquiry. Hotel breakfast is generally included and you can choose suitable items or skip it. When lunch or dinner is in the quote, we arrange a halal restaurant or packed meal, or refund that meal if we cannot confirm a suitable option. When those meals are not in the quote, the driver-guide helps you find a restaurant or takeaway. Prayer-time reminders and a quiet place or mosque can be arranged when the route allows. We do not claim certified-halal hotel kitchens.
faqFinal: Does submitting this form commit me to a booking?
No. It starts a conversation about your plans. You can review the proposal and terms before deciding whether to proceed.

about.metaTitle: Meet Joy Liu | About Hidden China Travel
about.metaDescription: Meet Joy Liu, Yunnan-born founder of Hidden China Travel, and discover the local insight and thoughtful planning behind our private Yunnan journeys.
about.ogImageAlt: Joy Liu, founder of Hidden China Travel
about.whatsappMessage: Hi Joy, I read your story on the About page and would love to discuss a Yunnan trip.
about.heroImageAlt: A traditional Bai courtyard in Xizhou, Yunnan
about.heroText: I’m Joy Liu. Born in Yunnan, shaped by journeys across China and beyond. I created Hidden China Travel to help you feel confident here—and discover a China that stays with you.
about.founderAlt: Joy Liu, founder of Hidden China Travel
about.founderHeadingB: Travel changed how I see it.
founderParagraphs: I’ve travelled through most of China’s major tourist cities—from Beijing, Shanghai and Xi’an to Guangzhou, Xiamen, Qingdao, Chongqing, Chengdu and Wuhan—and explored places as different as Guilin and Xinjiang.

Abroad, I’ve watched sunsets in Kota Kinabalu, dived off Bohol, gone sea fishing in Phuket and chased waves at Shirahama in Japan. But the most important thing I brought home wasn’t a longer list of places.

At first, I travelled the way many of us do: following the crowds, moving quickly and making sure I had seen every famous sight. Gradually, I began to care less about how much I could fit in—and more about how a journey made me feel.

A slow coffee in an old town. A stream beside an open field. Blue sky, with nowhere I needed to rush. Leaving an office building behind for a mountain landscape, I was still the same person, but in a very different frame of mind.
about.founderSignature: That is the feeling I want to help you find in China.
about.originHeading: I know how much work goes into feeling carefree.
originParagraphs: I know the other side of travel, too: comparing hotel reviews, checking ticket times, wondering whether weather will close an attraction, or realising the last bus from a remote spot may leave before you do.
In a country where you don’t speak the language, even a small problem can feel much bigger. I’ve felt that uncertainty myself.

Hidden China Travel grew from a simple idea: you should arrive in China feeling curious, not overwhelmed. Our free guides answer the practical questions. Our personal trip planning brings your ideas together into a journey you can look forward to.
about.originLink: See how we help you prepare for China →
about.philosophyImageAlt: Everyday life beside the river in Shaxi, Yunnan
philosophyParagraphs: The Forbidden City and the Great Wall deserve their place in your imagination. But there is also a China of village markets, mountain mornings, small family restaurants and unhurried afternoons beside the water.
You don’t have to choose between famous places and personal discoveries. The difference is leaving enough time to enjoy both.
We begin in Yunnan, the place I call home: a natural starting point for journeys through old towns, living traditions and extraordinary landscapes.
about.philosophyLink2: Plan a Yunnan journey around your own ideas →
about.quoteBy: Joy Liu · Founder, Hidden China Travel
about.whyHeading: Why plan your journey with us?
about.whySub: Personal attention, practical thinking and local insight—so you spend less time figuring things out and more time enjoying where you are.
reasons: A local perspective. A traveller’s understanding.
Yunnan is home, and travelling across China and abroad has shaped how I see it. I understand both the places you want to explore and the questions you may not know to ask.
A real person, not a booking queue.
You speak directly with me about your trip. Your interests, questions and preferences guide the conversation instead of getting lost between sales messages and standard packages.
The details behind a good day.
A beautiful route is only the beginning. We work through driving time, hotel location, walking demands, ticket arrangements and seasonal conditions before anything is confirmed.
A journey built around you.
Private travel gives us room to shape the pace, choose meaningful experiences and leave space to enjoy them. Famous sights and quieter discoveries both belong—when they are right for you.
about.bookingSub: Trust means knowing who you are speaking to, what you are paying for and who will welcome you on the ground.

about.faqHeading: A few things you might be wondering
about.faqSub: Good journeys begin with clear answers.
about.faqDirectQ: Will I speak with Joy directly?
about.faqDirectA: Yes. Joy Liu is your travel consultant at the licensed agency. He helps you clarify your ideas and stays with you from the first enquiry through the journey.
about.faqOperatorQ: Who operates the trip and handles payment?
about.faqItineraryQ: Do I need a finished itinerary?
about.faqItineraryA: No. Tell Joy roughly when you want to travel, who is coming and what you enjoy. You can start with an existing journey or discuss adjustments to the route, hotels and pace.
about.faqWeatherQ: What if weather or availability changes?
about.faqWeatherA: Weather, attraction access and hotel availability can change. Alternatives and any effect on price or schedule are discussed with the operator; your booking terms explain changes and cancellations.
about.ctaHeading: Let’s start with your kind of journey.
about.ctaText: A few dates, a place you’ve been dreaming about, or simply how you want the trip to feel. Tell me what’s on your mind.
about.ctaNote: Speak directly with Joy Liu. No commitment to book.
